title: AI-designed CRISPR-Cas editor performs precision human genome editing
summary: Language models generated Cas9-like effectors (4.8x more protein clusters than found in nature) and sgRNAs; several generated editors matched or exceeded SpCas9 in human cells and one was used for precision editing of the human genome. Abstract only reviewed: off-target breadth, clinical performance and independent replication not assessed.
ai_technology: Protein language models trained on >1M CRISPR operons
